summary: Cold SRanger codegen: 9 files, 3 modes, 7 spec transitions plus a Final tick self-loop. 5 items flagged for review.

issues.title: Final mode given a tick self-loop
issues.raw: SR-FR3 describes Final as terminal and lists no outgoing transition; the codegen rules require every mode to have one.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm that Final --tick--> Final (no action) is acceptable. It is an additional transition not enumerated in SR-Beh1..7 (SR-DC1).

issues.title: Moving->Turning: event AND guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 fires on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected guards the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as obstacle event && obstacleDetected. An obstacle event with distance above threshold is ignored.

issues.title: Clock unit vs method name
issues.raw: Spec times are in seconds; the pipeline's clock-read convention is nowMs().
issues.fix_directive: Clock.nowMs() reports time in the constants' unit (seconds) so TURN_DURATION=2.0 means 2 s.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default 1.0e6 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires a 'large default value' without a number.
issues.fix_directive: Default is 1.0e6 m; NaN/negative measurements are treated as no reading.

issues.title: Initial Move issued in constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1: on entering Moving (including power-up) issue Move(moveVel,0).
issues.fix_directive: The constructor issues Move(MOVE_VEL, 0.0); step() transitions into Moving issue it inline.
